canadian_mission.name: Embassy of Canada to Türkiye (also offers consular services to Canadians in Iran; Canada has no mission in Iran)

notes_for_senders.fact: Canada Post: 'Iran: Postal services suspended' (posted March 12, 2026): 'Postal services have been suspended to Iran due to the lack of available transportation.' Canada Post status page lists Iran as not accepting mail and parcels due to a temporary service disruption. This concerns mail sent from Canada to Iran; no official source was readable for mail from Iran to Canada.
Canada Post status page, red alert: 'Canada Post is not accepting mail and parcels for these destinations due to a temporary service disruption' - Iran posted March 12, 2026.

unverified_skipped: Iran Post (post.ir) refused connections; no official current source on outbound mail from Iran to Canada, price or transit time.
Iran is not listed on the IRCC 'Find a visa application centre' page (no VAC in Iran), so the field is null.

Canadian mission: the Canada-and-Iran page lists the Ankara embassy as 'Offering consular services to Canadians in Iran'; that page was opened but it is the Iran country page, not the Ankara mission page.
